_comment: Scenarios for the ports evolver (ports_app.py, ports_evolve.py): the lab's parts and rules (docs/design/energy-ports-2026-11.md). silhouette: a file in samples/. level: parts up to that level. allow: part ids it may use (empty: all). budget: credits (the lab's first-guess costs). points: build points (1 a cell below level 10, 1.6 below 24, 2.5 above; the core is free). start_parts: [type, x, y, rot, flip] placed on the start (the right half and centre line). power_s: seconds of the power phase. fire: {on, off} seconds (no off: held). enemy_armour: against each gun's pen (the penetration table). incoming: the hits (damage, pen, dps, from, spread, flank, max_s). seeds: one hit run each. weights: each measure against the start's (a measure the start has none of against a fixed scale: wiring 1, live_conduits 10, sustained_dps 50). Measures: damage_before_down (damage dealt, after the enemy's armour, until the core goes), sustained_dps (power phase), systems_kept, alive_s, half_s, wiring (for each unfed port, the share of its shortest path to power built with conduits pointing the right way, a conduit counting fully once power reaches it; at most 1 a port), live_conduits (still carrying power at the end of the power phase), engine_zone, thrust_to_mass. Penalties: unpowered (guns, engines and shields getting under a quarter of what they want over the power phase), blocked (guns with the ship in front, engines with it behind), no_engines, shape_off, clashes (two outs or two ins facing).

scenarios.name: Gunship: head-on fight
scenarios.about: Most hits at the nose; scored on damage dealt before going down. Starter-to-mid parts.

scenarios.name: Capital: Sunbreaker
scenarios.about: A capital ship built around a Sunbreaker at the nose: six lines of 60 to fill, heavy armour to beat (4), hard hits from the front.
